description: Exact field-level runtime data changes for the July 2026 balance-v4 playtest. Old values are retained here so the preset can be reverted without replacing unrelated CSV edits.

description.old: Increases coal mining output by 20% permanently.
description.new: Increases coal mining output by 15% permanently.

description.old: Increases iron ore mining output by 20% permanently.
description.new: Increases iron ore mining output by 15% permanently.

description.old: Increases limestone, sand and salt mining output by 20% permanently.
description.new: Increases limestone, sand and salt mining output by 15% permanently.

description.old: Increases copper ore mining output by 20% permanently.
description.new: Increases copper ore mining output by 15% permanently.
Increases coal, iron, copper, limestone, sand and salt mining output by a further 15% permanently.

description.old: Increases rare earth and alloy ore mining output by 20% permanently.
description.new: Increases rare earth and alloy ore mining output by 15% permanently.

description.old: Increases rare earth, alloy, sulphur and bauxite mining output by 20% permanently.
description.new: Increases rare earth, alloy, sulphur and bauxite mining output by 15% permanently.

description.old: Unlocks new recipes: Electric Arc Steelmaking (22 Steel); ELYSIS Aluminium (15 Aluminium); Flash Copper Smelting (36 Copper Ingots).
description.new: Unlocks new recipes: Electric Arc Steelmaking (50 Steel); ELYSIS Aluminium (15 Aluminium); Flash Copper Smelting (36 Copper Ingots).

description.old: Unlocks new recipe: Lithium Phosphate Batteries (6 Lithium Battery).
description.new: Unlocks new recipe: Lithium Phosphate Batteries (8 Lithium Battery).

description.old: Unlocks new recipe: Iron Air Batteries (12 Iron Battery).
description.new: Unlocks new recipe: Iron Air Batteries (6 Iron Battery).

description.old: Unlocks new recipe: Fluidised Bed Reactor + CZ Silicon (8 Polysilicon).
description.new: Unlocks new recipe: Fluidised Bed Reactor + CZ Silicon (6 Polysilicon).

description.old: Unlocks new recipe: Membraneless Electrolysis (6 Hydrogen).
description.new: Unlocks new recipe: Membraneless Electrolysis (22 Hydrogen and 11 Oxygen).
